Role: Head of Engineering
Company: xpate
Location: London or remote
Job Type: Full-time


About xpate

xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore.

The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand.

xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents.

What you will do

  • Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team.

  • Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.

  • Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts.

  • Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later.

  • Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision.

  • Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own.

First 6 months

  • Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter.

  • Months 4–6: build the harness on top, so non-engineering teams can prompt agents, create their own tools and run their workflows.

What you need to succeed

  • You have built financial systems: ledger, reconciliation, processing, gateway, double-entry accounting. Ideally you wrote them yourself, and you know what a few cents of error cost at scale.

  • You have a strong data architecture background.

  • You can hold the full technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.

  • You are a senior engineer with proven results. Team size doesn’t matter – leading 4–5 people is fine.

  • You know code quality and review still matter, and you are ready to change how the work gets done.

  • You think and talk like a business person.

  • You are a mature operator: collaborative, transparent, no “I know best”. You change things carefully and still make bold calls.

  • Payments or acquiring background is not required – any financial systems experience works.

  • Nice to have: you have rebuilt or transformed a team before.

  • Nice to have: you are based in London.

What you get

  • A new role with a clear mission: transform the platform and the way the company works.

  • Direct work with the founders, reporting to the CEO.

  • A team of about 15 engineers to inherit and reshape.

  • A profitable company moving into Payfac-as-a-Service and embedded distribution.

  • An AI-native setup where non-engineers build their own tools.

  • Year 1 is fixed pay. From year 2, shadow equity tied to P&L performance, with a path to real equity. Details to be agreed.

This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why This Role

We are looking for a sharp, motivated, commercially minded Commercial Counsel to join BFL’s legal team. You will support a broad range of commercial transactions across our EU and US go-to-market deals. This is a high-ownership role in which you will draft, review, and negotiate agreements, and help structure and maintain operations across the legal and go-to-market teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for a lawyer who wants to work at the cutting edge of AI: advising on novel agreement structures for foundational generative AI models, negotiating complex licensing and API deals, and helping build the legal and commercial infrastructure of a high-growth company.

What You’ll Work On

  • Partner closely with the GTM, Marketing, FDE, Infrastructure, and Finance teams to negotiate contracts and provide practical, deal-enabling legal advice

  • Support EU (and, as needed, US and UK) commercial transactions, focusing primarily on EU-centric deals across a variety of industry verticals, and advise on German corporate law

  • Contribute to company-wide compliance and legal operations initiatives as the legal team scales

  • Help develop and maintain scalable legal frameworks, contract templates, playbooks, and approval workflows

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of legal experience, including commercial transactions in the technology sector, ideally spanning both in-house roles and private practice. Start-up or high-growth company experience would be an advantage.

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing complex technology agreements, including software licensing, API and platform deals, data and content agreements, and partnership contracts.

  • Prior experience supporting EU commercial deals, with comfort navigating cross-border transactions and a strong awareness of key jurisdictional differences.

  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify material issues quickly and communicate them clearly to non-lawyers.

  • Low ego and high accountability: as comfortable rolling up your sleeves on routine agreements as you are handling high-stakes or novel deal structures.

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience negotiating robotics, technical manufacturing, and hardware contracts

  • Experience with products subject to export regulation in the EU

  • Experience with AI/ML, developer platforms, or foundational model licensing

  • Exposure to generative AI in prior roles; familiarity with how AI products are built, licensed, and deployed will meaningfully accelerate your effectiveness in this role

  • A JD from an accredited law school and qualification in Germany or the UK

  • Familiarity with German corporate law, the EU AI Act, GDPR, or other international regulatory frameworks relevant to AI and data

  • A background advising on IP, copyright, or data licensing matters in the context of AI training or model development

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation

EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

  • Projektleitung: Du leitest Beratungsprojekte, führst Dein Projektteam und übernimmst Verantwortung für den Projekterfolg, die Qualität der Ergebnisse und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden

  • Methodenentwicklung: Du entwickelts unsere Methoden und Beratungsansätze im Transportation Management gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter und teilst Deine Expertise mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen und unseren Kunden

  • Marktbearbeitung und Akquise: Du identifizierst Beratungsbedarf im Transportation Management, baust Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst passgenaue Angebote – vom ersten Austausch bis zur Präsentation unseres Beratungsansatzes

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5–6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Transportation Management mit und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Beratung sowie in der Leitung von Projekten gesammelt

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit: Transportstrategien, Target Operating Models, IT-Strategien sowie in der Auswahl und Implementierungsbegleitung von TMS-Lösungen. data.title: Senior Business Transformation Advisor - Planning & Materials Management

data.description:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps.  You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks.
  • Take an end-to-end view of features: understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries.
  • Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR. 
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

Must haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure.
  • Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs, including unit and integration tests.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and privacy, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data.
  • Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture, with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry.
  • Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments.


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We’re excited to get to know you!

Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Systeme spielen in Clubs, auf Festivals, in Bars, Hotels und Restaurants.

Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite. Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf.

Deine Rolle

Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline.

Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert.

  • Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop.

  • Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen.

  • Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos.

  • AI-First denken: Abläufe in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service automatisieren

  • Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten

  • Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen

  • Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte)

  • Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung

  • Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C

Das erwartet dich

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf

  • Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound zwischen Club, Festival und Wohnzimmer

  • Deliver actionable insights on campaign performance, drivers of customer behavior, value-generating segments, and cross-market differences
  • Develop scalable, automated reporting solutions alongside deep-dive analyses and ad hoc business investigations
  • Monitor and optimize key CRM KPIs (engagement, conversion, retention, reactivation, communication effectiveness) and customer lifecycle performance
  • Partner with CRM, data, and product teams to improve segmentation, personalization, experimentation, tracking quality, and data reliability

  • Strong SQL expertise (CTEs, window functions, multi-table joins) in a modern cloud data warehouse, preferably Snowflake
  • Advanced Power BI skills including data modeling, DAX, and best-practice dashboard design and visualization

data.description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

  • You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.

Key responsibilities:

Hybrid bioprocess modelling

  • Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.

  • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.

  • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.

  • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.

  • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.

Transfer across organisms and scales

  • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.

  • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.

  • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.

Real-time Model-Predictive Control

  • Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.

  • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).

  • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts

Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew.

To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.

You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with Production, Quality and Engineering teams, as well as external providers and the appointed Responsible Level 3. Your rigor will directly contribute to the conformity, traceability and reliability of flight hardware.

Your mission

You will prepare and perform NDT inspections in accordance with approved procedures and acceptance criteria, assess results within the scope of your qualification, and alert the relevant stakeholders when you identify a discrepancy or technical concern.


What you will do

  • Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

  • Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

  • Interpret and evaluate indications within the scope of your qualification and against approved acceptance criteria; seek guidance or escalate complex or ambiguous cases.

  • Produce complete inspection reports and maintain traceability of results, equipment, parameters and applicable documents.

  • Check the condition and validity of inspection equipment, and report any need for maintenance, verification or replacement.

  • Coordinate with Production to schedule inspections at the right stage and help resolve inspection-related production blockers.

  • Raise non-conformities and contribute to root-cause investigations, corrective actions and their follow-up.

  • Contribute to updating work instructions, procedures, inspection plans and report templates, under the coordination of authorized personnel.

  • When needed, coordinate inspections performed by external providers and check that their deliverables and supporting documentation are complete.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of NDT practices and the development of internal capabilities, including UT where your experience allows.

  • Follow the site’s safety, quality and document-control requirements.


What you bring

  • Level 2 qualification in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) under EN 4179, NAS 410, ISO 9712; current qualifications are strongly preferred.

  • Professional experience in the space industry is required, ideally involving flight hardware or critical equipment.

  • Practical experience inspecting welds, metallic structures, pressure vessels, propulsion systems, machined parts or composite components.

  • Ability to read drawings, specifications, procedures and acceptance criteria, and produce accurate, clear inspection reports.

  • Good understanding of inspection traceability, equipment control and the handling of non-conforming results.

  • Ability to work within the scope of your qualification and consult the Level 3 or technical focal points whenever a decision falls outside that scope.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, both spoken and written, to operate in an international environment.


Especially valuable

  • UT qualification or practical experience, particularly inspecting critical parts or structures.

  • Experience with digital radiography, phased-array UT, automated inspection or composite inspection.

  • Experience working with a Responsible Level 3, external NDT providers or certification bodies.

  • Experience preparing or reviewing procedures, technical instructions or inspection plans.


How you work

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented, with a consistent focus on conformity and traceability.

  • Sound technical judgment and a pragmatic, production-focused mindset.

  • Autonomous and organized, with clear communication whenever a discrepancy or concern arises.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Production, Quality, Engineering and external providers.

  • Motivated to help build robust NDT capabilities for demanding space hardware.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. TL;DR

The Partner Marketing team extends Lovable’s reach by educating, engaging, and enabling partners globally to build market awareness and generate demand for their Lovable-powered solutions and services. We recruit prospective partners and support the onboarding and growth of existing ones as they build, launch, market, and scale their businesses through the Lovable Partner Ecosystem. We work closely with GTM partnerships, product partnerships, sales, and product marketing, and serve partner types from major technology and platform partners to the connectors, agencies, and independent experts who build with Lovable every day.

Why Lovable?

For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now.

Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too.

The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced, creative, results-oriented marketer to develop and execute partner marketing initiatives across our full partner ecosystem. Connectors and integration partners are the immediate priority: Lovable’s rapidly growing connector roster (spanning search, communications, CRM, and data) needs launches, positioning, and demand generation. You’ll also work with the Lovable Partner Program team to run co-marketing campaigns and programs at scale that drive customer acquisition and activation, helping partners grow their business with and through Lovable.

You’ll set and own Lovable’s marketing with, to, and through partners, and roll up your sleeves to execute across a high-volume, fast-moving roster.

Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que RÉGULATEUR (trice) TAD. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Notre mission est d'assurer le transport des personnes en situation de handicap, en apportant une aide précieuse à ceux qui en ont besoin. En tant que assistant(e) exploitation, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la coordination efficace de notre service de transport, garantissant une expérience fluide et ponctuelle pour nos clients. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. Rejoignez-nous pour faire une différence significative dans la vie de ceux qui comptent sur notre engagement et notre expertise.

Vos missions

1.Gestion des appels et suivi des transports

  • Modifier les tournées et répartir les courses si nécessaire.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard ou de changement.

  • Assurer une permanence téléphonique de 17h30 à 19h00, selon l'organisation du service.

2. Assistance aux conducteurs

  • Répondre aux questions et aux demandes des conducteurs.

  • Organiser les remplacements en cas d'absence.

  • Vérifier les prises et les fins de service.

  • Faire le lien entre les conducteurs et le service Exploitation.

  • Veiller au respect des consignes et des règles concernant les temps de conduite, de travail et de repos.

3. Gestion des réservations

  • Enregistrer les demandes de transport.

  • Vérifier et valider les réservations selon les règles du service.

4. Relation avec les usagers et les clients

  • Suivre l'incident jusqu'à sa résolution.

6. Gestion du stock de téléphones professionnels

  • Réinitialiser les téléphones ou organiser leur réinitialisation avant une nouvelle attribution.

👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

 

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

 

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

Missions / Activité annexe :

·       Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

·       Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

·       Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 3 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  •        Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  •        Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  •        Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  •        Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  •        Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  •        Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Candidature complète : curriculum vitae, lettre de motivation et coordonnées de 2 professeurs de référence


Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

          

 Connaissances :

·       Une expérience dans le domaine des essais expérimentaux et de la conception (par exemple en géotechnique/géophysique/géomécanique) ou un diplôme de fin d'études dans ce domaine.

·       Intérêt pour la modélisation numérique, la conception mécanique et l'électronique.

·       Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.

·       Utilisation de logiciels de design industriel.

·       Compétences en Python.

·       Expérience en laboratoire et esprit d'équipe.

. Connaissances en physique/mathématiques/mécanique

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Le projet AMRIT : 

Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que coordinateur scientifique du projet AMRIT dans le cadre d’Horizon Europe, l’ENSTA recherche un responsable scientifique et technique.

Les principales missions du responsable de projet sont les suivantes :

  • Coordonner la mise en œuvre globale du projet et en suivre l’avancement, notamment les lots de travail, les livrables, les jalons, les échéances et les indicateurs clés de performance, en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur scientifique et avec le soutien du personnel administratif d’ARMINES ;

  • Suivre les risques liés au projet, les écarts et les actions correctives, et proposer des mesures d’atténuation ou d’ajustement si nécessaire ;

  • Diriger et coordonner le consortium, en maintenant une communication régulière avec ses membres, en facilitant la collaboration entre les partenaires, en assurant une circulation efficace de l’information et en accompagnant les partenaires dans la mise en œuvre de leurs activités ;

  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions du consortium, notamment les réunions du comité de pilotage, les réunions techniques et les assemblées générales, ainsi que leur préparation et leur suivi ;

  • Coordonner la préparation des rapports et des livrables du projet, en regroupant les contributions des partenaires et en garantissant leur qualité ainsi que leur remise dans les délais ;

  • Contribuer à la communication, à la diffusion et à l’exploitation des résultats du projet, notamment par le biais d’ateliers et de conférences, en coordination avec les partenaires concernés ;

  • Assurer la liaison principale avec la Commission européenne, notamment en maintenant.

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole. 

 

Postes ouverts aux candidats :

Durée d’affectation souhaitée CDD de 18 mois dans les locaux de l’ENSTA à Brest. D’autres lieux d’affectation peuvent néanmoins être envisagés.

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest, 2 rue François Verny, 29200 Brest.

Le poste est à temps plein et comprend des déplacements en France et à l’étranger en fonction des besoins du projet.

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

    ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

     

    ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

     

    Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

    ********************************************************

    ENSTA (https://www.ensta.fr) is a higher education and research institution under the supervision of the Ministry of the defense. The school’s mission is to train civil and military engineering students, as well as highly qualified executives and PhD graduates for the public and private sectors, particularly in the fields of defence and security, transport, energy, maritime activities, digital technology and cutting-edge technologies.

    ENSTA supports the transformation of major national strategic sectors through its research, innovation and educational programmes, thereby addressing the challenges of national sovereignty. It comprises six teaching and research units (UFRs) which conduct applied research in close collaboration with industry.

    ENSTA is a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). As part of IP Paris, the school participates in the activities of IP Paris interdisciplinary centres, notably the Interdisciplinary Centre for Seas and Ocean (CIMO), co-founded with Ifremer and supported by the Defence Innovation Agency (AID) and the French research council CNRS. Researchers from the school also collaborate on studies led by interdisciplinary centres such as Hi-Paris – winner of the 2024 AI Cluster award – E4C and E4H, amongst others.

    Joining the school means becoming part of an institution committed to gender parity and professional equality, diversity and supporting its staff with disabilities, from the moment of recruitment and throughout their careers. To safeguard wellbeing at work, the school pursues an active policy on working conditions, based in particular on a healthy work-life balance.

    The AMRIT project : 

    Today in Europe, the operations of in situ observing platforms rely on a network of Research Infrastructures distributed all around Europe. The activities in the network include in situ and remote operations at sea and data management of a large number of assets for a wide variety of applications. Such activities rely on important IT resources, R&D to improve the capacity of the platforms, as well as managerial and financial activities to run the infrastructures and provide access to them. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) is a pioneering project designed to revolutionise the landscape of marine research infrastructures in Europe, strengthening their ability to respond to Europe's policy and global scientific challenges.

    AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) is a Horizon Europe & UKRI funded project, with 26 European partners, designed to advance Marine Research Infrastructures (MRIs). By developing tools and services integrating the operations of marine observation platforms, AMRIT aims to:

    •  Ensure seamless operation of marine observation platforms.

    •  Ensure the full nominal use of sensors and accelerate their evolution.

    •  Exploit the complementarity of the various observation platforms.

    •  Ensure the overall coherence of the ocean data value chain.

    •  Ensure a consistent and comprehensive list of metadata and descriptors.

    Mission of the Scientific and Technical Manager : 

    As third party of ARMINES, the administrative Coordinator of the Horizon Europe Project AMRIT, ENSTA is seeking a Scientific and Technical Manager. Under the supervision of the project Scientific Coordinator, Professor Laurent Mortier (ENSTA), the main tasks of the Project Manager are to:

    • Coordinate the overall implementation of the project and monitor its progress, including work packages, deliverables, milestones, deadlines and key performance indicators, in close collaboration with the Scientific Coordinator and with the support of ARMINES administrative staff.

    • Monitor project risks, deviations and corrective actions, and propose mitigation or adjustment measures where necessary.

    • Lead and coordinate the consortium, maintaining regular communication with consortium members, facilitating collaboration among partners, ensuring the effective flow of information and supporting partners in the implementation of their activities.

    • Organise and coordinate consortium meetings, including steering committee meetings, technical meetings and general assemblies, as well as their preparation and follow-up.

    • Coordinate the preparation of project reports and deliverables, consolidating contributions from partners and ensuring their quality and timely submission.

    • Contribute to the communication, dissemination and exploitation of project results, including through workshops and conferences, in coordination with the relevant partners.

    • Act as the main liaison with the European Commission, including maintaining regular communication and follow-up with the Project Officer.

    • Represent the consortium and build and maintain high-level relationships with key stakeholders at national, European and international levels.

    Required qualifications and skills :

    • Applicants must have an advanced university degree (M.Sc or equivalent degree) in Oceanography, Marine Science or Engineering, or related fields. A PhD in a relevant field is an advantage.

    • Applicants must have at least 5 years (PhD included) of relevant experience in ocean observations or services in ocean observation organisations.

    • Applicants must have demonstrated experience in coordinating, managing and implementing projects, desirably at the European or international level.

    • Excellent organizational, written and communication skills.

    • Professional command of both spoken and written English, and good knowledge of French and/or another European language.

    Desired qualifications and skills :

    • Motivation and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders on national, international (and interdisciplinary) levels including researchers, operators, administrative staff, science officers, and policy makers.

    • Degree in management of European affairs or similar.

    • Knowledge of major national and EU funding instruments.

    • Experience of working and collaborating among Research Infrastructures in the environmental field.

    Working conditions :

    ENSTA is committed to a recruitment process that promotes equality, diversity and inclusion. All applications, regardless of any distinction (age, disability, gender, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, etc.), are welcome in our recruitment process.

    The role is full-time and involves travel within France and abroad, depending on the project’s requirements. Remote working is possible in accordance with the employer’s current policies.

    Administrative :

    The position is for a duration of 18 months, based in ENSTA premises in Brest, Brittany. Other locations may be considered.

    Enquiries about the position should be addressed to Professor Laurent Mortier (). Enquiries regarding the detailed terms and conditions of employment at ENSTA can be addressed to Margot Provost ().

    To apply for this position, the full application must be submitted via the website https://enstaparis.recruitee.com/ by 27 September 2026, together with all the documents requested on the website.

    Please also send your CV, a covering letter, and the name of 2 referees in the project field, before 20th September 2026 to:

    • Margot Provost ()

    • and Pr. Laurent Mortier ()

    Interviews will be organised online with the shortlisted applicants.

    Complementary informations :

    The contract is financed by Grant Agreement 101132013 Horizon Europe - European Commission “Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together” (AMRIT)


    Connaissances :

    • Connaissance des principaux instruments de financement nationaux et européens ;

    • Expérience de travail et de collaboration au sein d’infrastructures de recherche dans le domaine de l’environnement.

    Savoir-faire: 

    • Motivation et capacité à interagir avec de multiples parties prenantes aux niveaux national, international (et interdisciplinaire), notamment des chercheurs, des opérateurs, du personnel administratif, des responsables scientifiques ou équivalent ;

    • Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit, et bonne connaissance du français et / ou d’une autre langue européenne.

    Aptitudes: 

    • Organisation ;

    • Rédaction ;

    • Communication.

    Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau supérieur (Master ou équivalent) en océanographie, en sciences marines, en ingénierie ou dans les domaines connexes.

    Un doctorat dans le domaine pertinent constitue un atout.

    Les candidats doivent justifier d’au moins 5 ans (doctorat compris) d’expérience pertinente dans le domaine des observations océaniques ou au sein d’organismes spécialisés dans ce domaine.

    Les candidats doivent justifier d’une expérience avérée dans la coordination, la gestion et la mise en œuvre de projets, de préférence au niveau européen ou international

En rejoignant l’équipe Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre !

Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Au sein de notre département Sales, tu retrouves :

  • les SDR, dont l’objectif est de qualifier les prospects et d’organiser des démos avec les Sales Executive

  • Sales Executive, dont l’objectif est d’accompagner les prospects sur la suite du cycle de vente jusqu’à la signature du contrat.

Pour signer un contrat avec une copropriété, il faut obtenir la majorité des votes des copropriétaires lors de l'Assemblée Générale annuelle (cycle de vente est long et complexe - 3 mois en moyenne).

Les missions au quotidien :

  • Gérer la relation avec les prospects :

  • Réaliser les démos avec les leads qualifiés par les SDR, et fixer clairement les prochaines étapes du cycle de vente,

  • Comprendre le rôle de tes interlocuteur·rices au sein de la copropriété, ainsi que les besoins et les problématiques rencontrées par tes prospects pour adapter l'offre proposée (Matera Plateforme, Syndic Coopératif, ou Local) et les convaincre que Matera est la bonne solution,

  • Établir une relation de confiance avec les copropriétaires, les présidents et les membres du conseil syndical,

  • Convaincre de façon directe et indirecte la majorité de la copropriété,

  • Pitcher la solution lors des Assemblées Générales pour obtenir la signature du contrat et faire la passation avec le département Care

  • Analyser des leviers pour améliorer la conversion,

  • Faire remonter les retours des prospects / clients pour participer à l’amélioration du produit,

  • Nous aider dans l'organisation d’événements clients,

  • Participer à l'amélioration continue du discours et des process en interne.

Onboarding et montée en compétences :

  • Sur les 6 premiers mois : tu vas monter en compétences sur la qualification des leads, le pitch aux prospects inbound et outbound, les produits de Matera, l’accompagnement dans le changement de syndic pour tes clients, les techniques de vente et tu vas te familiariser avec le monde de la copropriété (droit et compta notamment).

  • Ensuite : prise en main complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'à la signature des contrats - organisation et pitch lors des AG.

Les avantages

Les plus :

  • Package : 40€ à 65K selon profil et expérience,

  • 2 semaines d'onboarding pour comprendre le fonctionnement et les valeurs de Matera, et un onboarding spécifique à ton métier,

  • Un career path pour t’accompagner dans ton évolution professionnelle : accompagnement hebdomadaire par taon manager, 2 performances reviews par an, et politique de mobilité interne,

  • Politique de rémunération et de BSPCEs transparente,

  • Politique d’accompagnement à la parentalité : une reprise en douceur à 80% pendant 4 semaines (payées à 100%), ainsi que 5 jours de congés supplémentaires par an pour enfant malade,

  • Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables,

If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. The product is real; the French playbook is still being written. We are outsiders here, and we will earn our place through better conversations, sharper execution, and customers who see the difference.

We are outbound first. As our founding BDR in France, you will start conversations rather than wait for them. You will find the right companies, reach the people who own customer operations, and create qualified opportunities for the team. You will also help decide which messages, channels, and routines deserve to become our French sales playbook.

What you'll do

  • Build targeted account lists and find the people with a real customer interaction problem to solve.

  • Prospect every day through calls, email, LinkedIn, and thoughtful experiments. The phone is a core part of this role.

  • Run sharp first conversations: understand the workflow, volume, owner, urgency, and reason to act; then hand over opportunities with context the AE can use.

  • Test messages and sequences, measure what turns into useful conversations and qualified pipeline, and improve quickly.

  • Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging.

What makes you a great fit

  • You do not need sales experience. Your background could be the military, firefighting, competitive sport, or something else entirely. What matters is your discipline, coachability, rigor, and ability to keep going through rejection.

  • You speak clearly, listen closely, are curious about how businesses work, and are willing to learn a technical product. You are comfortable picking up the phone.

  • You care about the quality of the opportunity, not just the number of meetings on a calendar.

  • You take feedback directly, own your results, and keep moving when the answer is no.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You speak and write excellent French, work comfortably in English, are based in Paris, and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You need inbound leads, a finished script, or detailed direction before you can start.

  • You avoid the phone or repeated outreach.

  • You resist coaching or let a string of no's stop you from trying a better approach.

  • You value meeting counts over understanding whether a prospect has a real problem and reason to act.

The reality of the role

You will be one of the first people building telli's presence in France. There is no mature local demand engine or perfect script to inherit. Outbound is the core of this role, and some ideas will fail. You will make a lot of calls, learn fast, and help turn an early market into a repeatable business. If that sounds like the best challenge of your career, we want to meet you.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you open doors. Show us how you prepare, earn a first conversation, ask and listen, follow up, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the discipline and judgment you would bring to building pipeline in France.

Compensation

€60,000–€80,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.
